---
title: "wrapped fixture: metadata function values that print a warning"
filters:
  - wrapped
format: html
wrapped:
  breakpoint: calc(50%)
  width: calc(1px + 2)
---

![A wrapped figure.](plot.png){#fig-meta-calc-bad .wrap-right}

A media query takes no percent, so the breakpoint stays at its default, with a warning. A length plus a number is not a length, so the width stays at its default, with a warning.
